text:
maya: heads-up — I pushed the tighter egress default-deny to eu-west-1 earlier (rolled through infra policy). Seeing ~15% GPU nodes fail keystore/TLS handshake during warm pool joins.

jonas: ugh. which rule changed exactly? did we block privatelink or the keystore IPs?

maya: the rule was to drop outbound to 0.0.0.0/0 from gpu-subnet unless matched by allowlist. I added an allowlist for metrics/monitoring only. keystore endpoints are on the allowlist in prod, but staging/regional ones weren't.

lee: security perspective — the rule intent is right (reduce egress), but we need to ensure keystore & kms endpoints are explicitly permitted per region. If we re-add broad NAT egress we lose the audit improvement.

dave: operational impact: warm pool join failures spiked at 10:12UTC. metric snippets:
```
gpu_pool_join_success_rate: 0.98 -> 0.82
keystore_handshake_errors: +320 (10:12-10:20)
logs: "tls handshake failed: 403 forbidden from keystore-proxy.eu-west-1.internal"
```

maya: rollback in progress — reverting default-deny for the gpu-subnet to previous state to restore capacity. Doing a controlled revert, not reverting account-wide.

opsbot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated by maya at 1712583300 — policy-change rollback job started. :gear:

jonas: for remediation we should: 1) add region-specific keystore endpoints to infra allowlist (no 0.0.0.0/0), 2) add integration tests in CI that spin up a small warm pool and validate keystore handshakes during policy changes, 3) document the exception window for compliance. Also FYI NAT gateway egress cost will increase while we keep the revert.

lee: +1. also we should consider short-term compromise — allow VPC endpoint (privatelink) for keystore with endpoint policy scoped to the GPU role. That keeps auditability (no SNAT) and tightens the path. We'll need an IAM statement change on the keystore role and update the keystore's audit origin whitelist.

maya: agreed. I'll open INF-1234 and schedule a maintenance cutover for 03/24 02:00UTC to roll the scoped allowlist + privatelink. Will draft the compliance note and include exact IPs/endpoints.

dave: please add a runbook step: when tightening egress, run `curl -I https://keystore.internal.eu-west-1/ping` from a warm-node and verify 200 before policy flip. Saves a rollback.

jonas: we'll also add a metric alert: if keystore_handshake_errors > 50 in 5m during policy rollout, auto-abort and rollback.

lee: audit/logging ask: make sure keystore audit logs are forwarded to SIEM with 1y retention for now (compliance requested). That will be in the ticket.

maya: thanks team. rolling revert should finish in <10m, I'll post status. cc @compliance (for visibility) :eyes:
